content.text: {"posting_id":"8128745","verdict":"not_relevant","justification":[{"resume_field":"job_search.target_titles","posting_field":"title","evidence":"Title \"Software Engineer, Intern (Summer or Winter)\" contains the target title \"Software Engineer\" but also the excluded word \"Intern\", which overrides target titles, so R1 fails."},{"resume_field":"job_search.work_country","posting_field":"location.name","evidence":"\"San Francisco, Seattle, New York City\" shows US cities, so R3 passes."},{"resume_field":"job_search.years_experience","posting_field":"content","evidence":"The content has no \"N+ years\", range, or plain \"N years\" patterns (only \"At least 1 year\", which is singular and not an N-years match), so R4 is unknown."},{"resume_field":"job_search.needs_sponsorship","posting_field":"content","evidence":"No phrases such as \"unable to sponsor\" or \"no sponsorship\" are present, so R5 passes."},{"resume_field":"skills","posting_field":"content","evidence":"The content says \"We work mostly in Ruby, Java, Javascript, Go, and Scala\", which includes the whole word \"Java\", so R6 passes."},{"resume_field":"job_search.target_titles","posting_field":"first_published","evidence":"first_published 2026-08-31 is 57 days before run date 2026-10-27, but updated_at is not used when first_published exists, so R2 fails."}]}
